ungated_globs.*.md: prose; there is no markdown linter this repo has agreed to, and a gate nobody agrees with is one people bypass
ungated_globs.LICENSE: verbatim licence text, which must not be edited to satisfy anything
ungated_globs..gitignore: a list of paths; the gate that would matter is the coverage check itself, which reads the index and so already sees what this excludes
ungated_globs.*.json: configuration and lockfiles; malformed JSON fails the tool that reads it, which is a faster and more specific signal than a gate
ungated_globs.*.toml: configuration; policy/ruff-base.toml is exercised by every ruff run and pyproject.toml by every install and the packaging test
ungated_globs.*.yml: CI workflows and lefthook config; GitHub validates the first on push and lefthook the second on every hook run
ungated_globs.*.sh: KNOWN GAP, not a decision that these need nothing: shellcheck is not installed here and is not a dependency of this library. Nine scripts, including the two the git hooks execute.
ungated_globs.*.cjs: KNOWN GAP: ts_organization_check grades .ts and .tsx, and the one .cjs here is that gate itself. Grading it would mean the gate judging its own source under rules written for application code.
